prompt: Your presentation slides are walls of text and classmates lose track as you talk. Which redesign best helps an audience follow you?

options.text: Add even more detail to each slide so nothing is left out
Put one main idea on each slide and keep the detailed points in your spoken notes
Read the slides word for word so nothing gets missed
Add an animation to every line of text

explanation: One idea per slide gives the audience a single thing to take in at a time, while your spoken notes carry the detail — so listening and reading stop competing with each other.
